Alright, I've just completed the interactive testing of the UI changes in the temporary tmux session `glinttest4`. The capture shows the rendered table for Rust ownership without any duplicate tail lines, and the goal prefix stripping now correctly removes the leading `**Goal:**` marker. The UI behaves as expected, and the underlying logic for tail-only rendering appears solid after the edits to `src/tui.tsx`.

Now I need to verify that these source changes haven't introduced any TypeScript compilation errors, and that the project still builds cleanly into the distribution bundle. The previous steps already ran `bunx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` as part of the test script, and that returned `TSC_CLEAN`. However, that was before I made the final edit that removed the `tailOnly` property entirely and adjusted the goal refinement regex. Those changes could affect type definitions or other parts of the code that reference `tailOnly`, so I must re‑run the type‑checker after the final edit.

Assuming the type‑check passes, I should also rebuild the CLI so that the compiled binary in `dist/` reflects the latest source. The standard build command in this repo is `bun run build`. I don't need the build output printed to the console, so I’ll redirect both stdout and stderr to `/dev/null` to keep the logs clean.

Finally, to confirm that the built CLI is functional, I’ll invoke its `--version` flag. The binary lives at `./dist/glint` after a successful build, and printing the version will serve as a quick sanity check that the executable runs.

Before I do all that, I should clean up the tmux session I spun up for testing (`glinttest4`) to avoid orphaned sessions and potential port conflicts. I can kill it with `tmux kill-session -t glinttest4`, silencing any errors by redirecting stderr to `/dev/null`.

Putting it all together, a single Bash command that (1) kills the test session, (2) runs the TypeScript compiler without emitting files, (3) builds the project, and (4) prints the version should suffice. I’ll also set a generous timeout (180 seconds) to give the build enough time, especially on slower CI runners.

Thus, the appropriate tool call is a Bash execution with the composed command:
`tmux kill-session -t glinttest4 2>/dev/null; bunx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1 && ./dist/glint --version`.

That will verify the codebase is clean, rebuild the CLI, and confirm the version output, all while cleaning up the test environment.
